brand.$description: The slots a clinic palette replaces (PLT-41). The server-side palette must meet the pairs declared for these slots in contrast-pairs.json.

primary.$description: Primary buttons, links, the selected tab and active marks.

primary-hover.$description: A primary button or link under the pointer.

on-primary.$description: Text and icons on a primary fill.

primary-soft.$description: A soft brand fill: the current navigation entry, a highlighted card, a soft button.

accent.$description: Gold: a fill, border or mark colour (the current item, the queue badge ring), never body text on a light surface.

on-accent.$description: Text and icons on a gold fill.

accent-soft.$description: A soft gold fill: a featured note, a tip.
